title: Zoe slider
description: A swipeable card row that snaps card by card and runs off the right edge, with a full-width hairline progress bar whose dark fill grows card by card (0.3s) and two round chevron buttons underneath, flush left.
notes: native scroll-snap, no carousel library; the progress bar and arrows need JavaScript (hydrate visible)
tone="band" makes the bar and buttons translucent white, for coloured bands
hide the controls at a breakpoint with controlsClassName (e.g. lg:hidden when every card fits)
